people.name: Braxton Brackin
people.alt: Braxton Brackin in a pink western shirt and straw hat, holding a buckskin horse at a rodeo arena
people.bio: Raised around rodeo and riding for 27 years, Braxton learned calf roping from her uncle before she could walk. She still competes, and teaches with a firm but encouraging style that helps students believe they can do anything they set their minds to.

people.name: Anna Foote
people.alt: Anna Foote cheek to cheek with a dark horse with a white blaze, mountains behind
people.bio: Born and raised in Cody, Wyoming, Anna rode six years with a rodeo drill team before moving to Oklahoma after college in 2023. She loves breakaway roping and teaching riders of every age, and making it fun.

people.name: Chloe Bjornberg
people.alt: Chloe Bjornberg in a navy show jacket, standing with a dapple grey horse
people.bio: A former president of the OU Equestrian Team, Chloe has taught English and western lessons for over eight years. She's now in graduate school at OU, working toward becoming a counselor who offers equine-assisted therapy.
